rows.grounds: locative of compound durgā-pīṭha indicating the place of worship
past passive participle agreeing with durgā+pīṭhe
direct object of meditation and worship

items.question: What preparatory act and location are required for the proper worship of the goddess?
premises: The Durgā seat has been previously declared.
The goddess is the object of meditation.
Meditation precedes the act of worship.
items.inference: One should meditate on the goddess and then worship her at the previously declared Durgā seat.
items.plain_english: Having meditated on the goddess at the previously declared Durgā seat, one should worship her.
